reference_description: A frosted glass dropper bottle with a soft pinkish-mauve tone. The bottle is cylindrical with gently rounded shoulders, a short neck, and a wide body that tapers slightly at the base. The closure system consists of a rose-gold/champagne metallic collar (wide, prominent, approximately 1/4 the bottle height) that threads onto the neck, topped by a large smooth rounded rubber pipette bulb in deep plum/aubergine color. The bulb is hemispherical-to-ovoid, clearly exposed above the collar. Label reads 'BBROSE Rose Damascena Night Repair Oil'. Overall silhouette is tall and elegant, with the bulb and collar together forming roughly 30% of total height.
output_description: A synthetic render showing a squat, wide cylindrical bottle body in off-white/cream color with very little neck definition. The top closure area consists of a flat, stepped beige/cream disk-like collar that is disproportionately wide and flat compared to reference. Above the collar sits a very small, flat-topped trapezoidal dark plum shape — not a rounded bulb, but more like a truncated pyramid or flat pad. The body is extremely wide and short relative to the reference, giving a jar-like appearance rather than a dropper bottle. No gold/metallic collar visible; no bottle neck visible; bottle proportions are completely wrong.
top_component_observed_shape: Flat-topped truncated trapezoid (small dark plum pad sitting on a wide stepped cream disk)

component_semantics.evidence: The dark shape at the top is not a rounded rubber bulb — it is a flat, angular truncated trapezoid with no curvature. It does not match the exposed rubber pipette bulb of the reference. The collar is beige/cream flat disk instead of a tall rose-gold metallic band.
